description: A player-owned sampled projectile, built through Sand's shared flight runtime.

damage.description: Native damage in hit points, attributed to the launching player.

hit.description: Player function run at the first block or entity impact.

id.description: Identity used to launch or cancel flight.

radius.description: Entity collision radius. Defaults to half a block.

speed.description: Speed in blocks per tick. Defaults to one.

target.description: Filter potential hits to this entity type.
